name: Galam Ltd.
summary: Galam Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, marketing, and sales of food products in Israel, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Industrial, FoodTech, and Marketing and Trading segments. The company offers GOFOS, a multifunctional prebiotic fiber used for sugar reduced applications; and Fruitose, a beet sugar based crystalline Fructose used for sugar and calories reduction. It also provides starches; glucose syrup; organic liquid sugar, organic inverted sugar, organic agave fructose syrup, organic liquid fiber, and organic fiber syrup; and additional nutritional components, such as protein, sprouts, and oils and fibers to compounding plants as animal feed.
